attributes.name: Devil Armor
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2.

If proficient with heavy armors, recharge this card to reduce Combat or Fire damage dealt to you to 0. Then if this card has the Corrupted trait, search the blessings deck until you find 2 blessings and banish them; if you also have the Hellknight trait, search for and banish 1 instead.

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
